resources.string: No offline voice to read with. Download one in Text-to-speech in your phone settings.
Two quick one-time steps, then hold the mic button anywhere to dictate.
Append a space after each dictated phrase, so the next one doesn\'t run in.
Microphone permission needed, open VoxScribe app to grant it
The microphone would not start. Close any app that is recording and try again.

Lets VoxScribe\'s floating bubble (an alternative to switching keyboards) detect which text field is focused and insert your dictated text into it directly. While you dictate it also reads the words on screen, on your phone only, to spell names right and to fill forms by voice, and it notices when you fix a word it typed so it can spell it your way next time. VoxScribe does not log, keep, or transmit anything you type or see, apart from those fixes, which stay on your phone.
VoxScribe floating bubble. Drag to move, hold or tap to talk.
Recording, release or tap to stop
Shown while VoxScribe\'s floating dictation bubble is active
Hold or tap the bubble anywhere to dictate
Couldn\'t insert directly, copied to clipboard instead
An alternative to switching keyboards: a small bubble floats over any app. Hold it to talk, release to insert the text right where you\'re typing.
Opens Accessibility settings, find and turn on \"VoxScribe\" in the list.
Grant overlay + accessibility permissions first (steps 1 and 2 above)
Bubble is active, drag it anywhere, hold or tap to talk.
The floating button is hidden. Tap here, then switch VoxScribe off and on again in Accessibility.
Tip: tap the button once to start and again to stop. You can change this in Settings.
VoxScribe is hidden for 10 minutes. Use the notification to bring it back.
Not typing into a password field.
Filling a whole form by voice is part of VoxScribe Pro. Your 5 free fills are used up.
Drop here to hide for 10 minutes
No speech heard. Check the microphone is not muted.
Hands-free: talk, and each phrase is typed when you pause. Say \"stop listening\" or tap to end.
Too short to hear. Hold the button the whole time you talk.
Too short to hear. Tap once, talk, then tap again to stop.
Too short to hear. Tap once, talk, then tap again. Or hold the button while you talk.
The microphone heard nothing. Check it is not muted or being used by a call or another app.
Very quiet. Hold the phone closer, or speak a little louder.
Heard sound but no words. Try again a little slower, closer to the phone.
